paper.title_en: Black hole thermodynamics at null infinity. Part 1: Dual Generalized Second Law
paper.abstract_en: The generalized second law (GSL) of black hole thermodynamics asserts the monotonic increase of the generalized entropy combining the black hole area and the entropy of quantum fields outside the horizon. Modern proofs of the GSL rely on information theoretic methods and are typically formulated using algebras of observables defined on the event horizon together with a vacuum state invariant under horizon symmetries, inducing a geometric modular flow. In this work, we formulate a dual version of the generalized second law from the perspective of asymptotic observers at future null infinity, who do not have access to the black hole area. Our approach exploits the dependence of the second law on the choice of algebra of observables and of a reference state invariant under suitable symmetries, in close analogy with open quantum thermodynamics. Using algebraic quantum field theory and modular theory, we analyze several physically motivated vacuum states, including the Hartle Hawking state and two classes of regularized vacua. We show that, at null infinity, the monotonic quantity governing an irreversible evolution is no longer the generalized entropy, but rather a thermodynamic potential constructed from asymptotic observables. Depending on the chosen vacuum, this potential takes the form of the free energy or of a generalized grand potential built from the Bondi mass and additional (angular) mode dependent chemical potentials. The resulting inequalities define a dual generalized second law at future null infinity, which can be consistently combined with the standard GSL involving variations of the black hole area.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 选题契合黑洞热力学主题，从渐近观测者视角重构广义第二定律，涉及模理论与代数量子场论，理论深度和原创性较强，摘要表述清晰，值得点击进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 零类无穷处的黑洞热力学。第1部分：对偶广义第二定律
decision.abstract_zh: 黑洞热力学的广义第二定律（GSL）断言，结合黑洞面积与视界外量子场熵的广义熵单调增加。现代对GSL的证明依赖信息论方法，并且通常使用定义在事件视界上的可观测量代数以及一个在视界对称性下不变的真空态来表述，从而诱导出一个几何模流。在本工作中，我们从未来零类无穷处的渐近观测者的视角出发，构建广义第二定律的一个对偶版本，这些观测者无法获得黑洞面积。我们的方法利用了第二定律对可观测量代数选择以及对在适当对称性下不变的参考态选择的依赖性，这与开放量子热力学密切相关。利用代数量子场论和模理论，我们分析了几种具有物理动机的真空态，包括Hartle-Hawking态和两类正则化真空。我们表明，在零类无穷处，支配不可逆演化的单调量不再是广义熵，而是由渐近可观测量构造出的一个热力学势。取决于所选择的真空，该势取自由能的形式，或取由Bondi质量和附加的（角）模依赖化学势构造出的广义巨势的形式。由此得到的不等式在未来零类无穷处定义了一个对偶广义第二定律，它可以与涉及黑洞面积变化的标准GSL一致地结合。
